en.html:
Contact.

My low sweep caught him above the knee and bit in, cutting a deep gash in the armor.

Not enough to sever the leg, but the blow should have reached the bone. That injury would certainly hamper his movement. If he could not step in properly, the force of his cuts would suffer too.

A substantial advantage. Mine.

The advantage was clear. Surely he knew it too.

For all his apparent temper, Shishiku Ootori seemed to keep cold judgment foremost in battle. Then perhaps, if I tried speaking again, he could set his bloodlust aside and decide...?

Right, left—his trembling legs dragged his body from side to side. It seemed to show uncertainty within him too.

Openings everywhere. I deliberately refrained from attacking. Naturally, I did not forget to keep my sword ready, its point threatening him.

Give this aggressive commander an opening, and he would attack through the injury. Of that I had no doubt.

en.html:
A side guard, point directed behind him. From that seated position he could step forward and sweep horizontally. But—

I see. Prepare a counterattack and let the leg recover at the same time.

Rest it, and the wound would heal faster. Moreover, I could not observe its progress. Standing, his posture would give it away. Seated without using the leg, nothing for me to read.

Resourceful under pressure. Admirable. ...Whether that resourcefulness achieved anything, however, depended on my decision.

Offering a truce in the middle of a sword fight might indeed be unbecoming weakness in a warrior. But kindly do not extend that assessment to my standing quietly while the enemy heals. I did not consider myself quite that accommodating.

ja.html:
切先を後方に向けた、脇構えに取っている。
　座位から一歩を踏み出し、横一文字に切り払う体勢
だ――が。

　そうか。
　反撃の用意と同時に、足の負傷の回復をも試みる肚
か。

　こうして足を休ませておけば、傷の治癒も早くなる。
　しかも、その回復状況を俺の観察眼から隠蔽できる。
立っていれば姿勢の変化で察せられるが、足を使わず
座っていては看破のしようがない。

　窮地にあってこの機転、賞賛に値する。
　……だが。その機転が意味を持つかどうかは、俺の
判断に依存する事だ。

　<ruby>太刀合<rt>たちあわせ</rt></ruby>の最中に休戦提案など、たしかに武人として
あるまじき惰弱な振舞いであったかもしれないが、と
いって敵の回復を黙って許すとまで<ruby>見縊<rt>みくび</rt></ruby>られては困る。
　そこまで甘くはないつもりだ。

Apart from appearance, the furious Shishiku was no different from before he put on his armor. Lord of Sasagawa. Lieutenant General of Rokuhara. The shogunate's last great commander.

Leader of Sasagawa's hundred thousand, the renowned general who had defeated even Yoritsuna Okabe, Danjou-no-in—

And yet. I could no longer ignore the enormous mismatch.

en.html:
Kageaki"A sword that bewilders the eye. A feigned severe injury. Then sleight of foot with a short sword."
Kageaki"One such move, I could accept as a hidden reserve for an emergency. But... three."
Kageaki"Lieutenant General, you are—"
獅子吼"Mind that tongue. Minato, was it..."
Kageaki"............"
獅子吼"...Yes. Originally... that is what I was."
獅子吼"No dissatisfaction with my lot. For Lord Tokiharu, the head before the last, I was prepared to bear any filth upon myself."
獅子吼"But the foolish last lord destroyed everything! Because of him I lost my proper role. To fulfill Lord Tokiharu's wishes, I had no choice but the insolence of taking his place!!"
獅子吼"You would never understand. I belonged in the shadows, yet emerged into public view—and invaded the office of the lord to whom I had sworn loyalty! This disgrace! This self-abasement! This self-defilement!"
Kageaki"............"
獅子吼"Laugh! Yes, exactly. Just as you so cleverly saw through me, this man exalted as Lieutenant General of Sasagawa is—¦nothing more than this creature of shadow!!"

en.html:
Something bitterly cold settled in my stomach. I shivered once.

Looking again with care, I could tell he seemed to have advanced half a step. That itself was fine; there was still room. Something else had made me shiver.

I could not tell immediately.

Even when he approached, I did not know at once. First inspect: movement, or illusion? That extra work... whichever way I considered it, fatal.

Immediate response was impossible. He could enter cutting range without my noticing. Strike then, and I could not prepare even a defense, let alone a counter. That would be the result.

No reasoning made this a winnable position.

腹の底に酷く寒いものを覚え、一度だけ震える。

　沈静して見直せば、敵手は半歩、近付いてきたよう
だと知れた。
　それ自体はいい。まだ間合のゆとりはある。震えた
のは、別の理解のためだった。

　<ruby>咄嗟に判別がつかない<rt>・・・・・・・・・・</rt></ruby>。

　対手が接近してきても、即時、それを知る事ができ
ない。錯覚か否か、検分する手間を要する。
　……どう考えても、これは致命的であった。

　敵の挙動に対する即応が不可能なのである。
　篠川公方が斬り間に踏み入ってきても、俺は察知し
得ない。そのまま彼が斬りつけてきても、反撃どころ
か防備さえ整えられない。……そうなる。

　これで勝てる道理がなかった。

en.html:
Fundamentally, nothing had changed.

Call my electromagnetic draw invincible, and all that meant was: under equal conditions, in a contest of sword speed, I would always win. Equal conditions. The same starting line. Those were the terms.

Were those the present terms? Naturally not. He had the privilege of detecting changes in distance before I did.

Whether he advanced or I rushed forward, when we reached one-step cutting range, only he would know immediately. I needed time to read his outline. I would be late, certainly.

With that disparity, even a godlike draw could sleep in its scabbard. No time to execute it. I would die by his blade.

Therefore, no victory without removing that basic disadvantage. To use the draw that guaranteed victory on equal terms, first I had to make the terms equal.

How?

In short: how to obtain his location. That was everything.

How could I use my perception, my senses, to get the information I needed?

Sight? My eyes barely caught that wavering outline. What further labor could I demand of them?

Hearing, then... but how reliable? Despite his overwhelming advantage, he was not rushing me. Surely because he was suppressing his footsteps. He knew sound could reverse this, and guarded against it.

Then read his breathing? Breathing reveals advance and retreat. ...But this man might even falsify that. Too accomplished in ambush and surprise.

ja.html:
根本的に、状況は<ruby>何も<rt>・・</rt></ruby>変わっていないという点だ。

　我が電磁抜刀に無敵の二字を冠せられるとしても、
それは『互角の条件で剣速比べをしたら必ず勝つ』と
いう程度の意味に過ぎない。
　互角の条件、要は同じ<ruby>開始線<rt>スタートライン</rt></ruby>に立つ前提で必勝。

　現況がそうかと問えば、無論違った。
　対手は今、間合の変化を俺に優先して察知する権利
を所有している。

　敵の前進によってあるいは俺の突出によって、互い
の距離が<ruby>一足一刀<rt>クロスレンジ</rt></ruby>まで至った時、敵側のみがその事実
を直ちに知るのだ。
　敵像の看取に時間を要するこちらは確実に遅れる。

　この格差があっては、神速の抜刀も鞘の中で眠りに
つくほかない。
　剣技を繰り出す暇に恵まれず、俺は斬死するだろう。

　……従って。
　大鳥獅子吼に対する勝利は、この根本的劣勢を取り
除かずして実現しない。

　<ruby>五分<rt>イーブン</rt></ruby>の対決において必勝手である電磁抜刀を生かす
ため、まず条件を五分に持ち込む手筈が必要なのだ。

　如何にすべきか。

　つまり――
　如何にして敵騎の<ruby>位置情報<rt>・・・・</rt></ruby>を掴むか。これに尽きる。

　俺の知覚、感覚を、どう活用すれば必要情報を得ら
れるのだろう？

　視覚か。
　……敵影をかくもあやふやな像でしか捉えられない
我が眼を、これ以上どう酷使のしようがあるのだろう。

　では聴覚……これとてどこまで当てになるか。
　圧倒的な優位にも拘わらず敵が一息に押して来ない
のは、足音を殺すために決まっている。音こそ逆転の
糸口たると彼はわきまえ、強く警戒しているのだ。

　ならば、呼吸でも読んでみるか。
　……呼吸は進退を如実に語る。だがこの男に限って
は、呼吸すら偽装しかねない。闇討奇襲の手管に長け
過ぎている。

I felt the moment drawing tight against my skin. Soon... time.

Doubts or no doubts, I had to decide. Stand here worrying indefinitely: that choice was merely suicide. To live and fulfill my purpose required another.

Then decide.

In this position... which sense should I trust?
